tools.name: Taskcluster pool replay
tools.description: Replay a mix of level-1 jobs into available worker-pool capacity.

beta.prerequisites: Python 3 and Pipenv. Replaying tasks also needs Taskcluster credentials and scopes; see the tool's help.

tools.name: Taskcluster task replay
tools.description: Replay a completed Firefox CI task as an independent diagnostic task.

beta.prerequisites: Python 3 and Pipenv. Replaying tasks also needs Taskcluster credentials and scopes; see the tool's help.

tools.name: Taskcluster task creator
tools.description: Submit test tasks to a worker queue to check workers. Can run custom commands.

default.prerequisites: Python 3 and Pipenv. Submitting tasks also needs Taskcluster credentials in ~/.tc_token with the required scopes.

tools.name: Taskcluster worker quarantine
tools.description: View quarantined workers, quarantine hosts, or lift their quarantine.

default.prerequisites: Python 3 and Pipenv. Changing quarantines also needs Taskcluster credentials and scopes; see the documentation.

tools.name: Moonshot oneshot tool — 24.04 X11 Talos
tools.description: Reimage and converge a Moonshot worker for Ubuntu 24.04 X11 Talos.

beta.prerequisites: Bash. Execution requires the helper's dependencies and host access.
beta.note: Replace 229 with the desired worker. Runs in dry-run mode by default.

tools.name: Moonshot oneshot tool — 24.04 Wayland Talos
tools.description: Reimage and converge a Moonshot worker for Ubuntu 24.04 Wayland Talos.

beta.prerequisites: Bash. Execution requires the helper's dependencies and host access.
beta.note: Replace 229 with the desired worker. Runs in dry-run mode by default.

tools.name: Fleetroll
tools.description: Audit and monitor Firefox CI hosts, and manage their Puppet configuration.

default.prerequisites: Requires uv and Python 3.11+. Host operations also need SSH access and the credentials described in the documentation.

tools.name: Fleetbench
tools.description: Run host benchmarks using the latest stable Fleetbench release.

default.prerequisites: A supported platform and public HTTPS access; no Git or Rust required.
